app.name: nooks
app.stillWaiting: Still waiting on the server. It's probably just waking up.

setup.title: Nooks is running.
setup.blurb: Make yourself an account and name the instance. Everything else can wait until someone asks for it.
setup.footer: People ask to join from the public list; you approve them
setup.passwordHint: Twelve characters or more. No other rules.
setup.instanceName: What should this instance be called?
setup.instanceNameHint: Shows in the sidebar and on printed lists.

replacePassword.eyebrow: An admin made you an account
replacePassword.title: Replace the temporary password
replacePassword.blurb: They had to pick the first one, so it can't stay. Choose your own now and theirs stops working.
replacePassword.footer: Required before you can use Nooks

join.title: Ask to join
join.blurb: An admin approves requests. Public signup is off, so this is the way in.
join.footer: Nothing is sent by email — the request waits in Nooks
join.emailPlaceholder: So they know who you are
join.sentBlurb: They'll approve it or they won't. This instance can't send email, so nothing will arrive in your inbox — ask them directly if it's taking a while.
join.sentFooter: Come back to this address once it's approved
join.approvedBlurb: That's the last step. Nobody else sees what you pick — not the admin, not the server logs.
join.nameHint: From your request. Change it if you like.

reset.title: Ask for a reset
reset.blurb: Nooks sends no email. An admin sees it in Activity, checks it's really you however they like, and approves it. Then you set a new password yourself.
reset.emailOrNameHint: So they know whose account to unlock.
reset.sentBlurb: They'll ask you something only you would know, then approve it. Come back to this address afterwards — the prompt to choose a password will be waiting.
reset.approvedBlurb: Nobody else sees what you choose — not the admin, not the server logs. The approval expires in an hour if you don't use it.

list.sharedCanEdit: Shared with the household · anyone can edit
list.emptyBody: Type below and press enter. Items can carry a quantity, a date and a note later — none of that is needed to start.
list.coldStartBody: Groceries, flat jobs, a book you keep meaning to find. A list is a name and a first item; sharing it with the household comes later.
list.namedCanEdit: Shared with specific people · they can edit
list.allDoneBody: Everything on it is ticked. What is done is at the foot of the list, and anything new goes below.

palette.searchHint: Type to find a list or an item.
palette.addListBlurb: Groceries, flat jobs, a book you keep meaning to find. It starts private.
palette.name: Name

error.unreachable: Something went wrong reaching the server.
error.screenBody: The server did not answer. Nothing you have written is lost — try again.
error.emailTaken: Somebody here already uses that email.

views.todayEmptyBody: Undated items are still sitting on their own lists. Nothing here is a good outcome, not a gap.
views.upcomingEmptyTitle: Nothing in the next two weeks
views.upcomingEmptyBody: Undated items stay where they are. A date is for something that has to happen on a day, not for everything.
views.calendarSubtitle: Everything with a date, from every list

note.hint: Press / for headings, checklists and quotes

share.title: Share “{{name}}”
share.blurb: Who can reach this list. Everything else in nooks stays private either way.
share.privateBlurb: Only you. Nobody else sees it in their sidebar.
share.instanceBlurb: Everyone here, including anyone who joins later.
share.specificBlurb: Choose who. Flatmates, family, or one person.
share.canEditBlurb: Off means read-only: see and print, not tick or add.
share.peopleBlurb: Groups first, then individuals. Picking a group shares with everyone in it, including people added to it later.
share.peopleFooter: It lands in their “Shared with me”.

activity.title: Activity
activity.noMailServer: nooks has no mail server to configure. Everything that needs your attention waits here.

members.title: Members
members.blurb: {{count}} person at {{name}}. Adding someone sets a temporary password you read out once; they must replace it on first sign-in.
members.blurb_other: {{count}} people at {{name}}. Adding someone sets a temporary password you read out once; they must replace it on first sign-in.
members.removeBlurb: Their account goes. What they added stays on its lists, still in their name.
members.addBlurb: They get a temporary password you read out once. nooks sends no mail, so how it reaches them is up to you.
members.name: Name
members.emailHint: Used to sign in. nooks never sends mail to it.
members.secretBlurb: Read it out, or write it down. It cannot be shown again — nooks keeps only a hash of it. They must replace it on first sign-in.

groups.title: Groups
groups.blurb: A group is a shortcut for sharing, and nothing else. Sharing a list with one reaches everyone in it, including anybody added later.
groups.addBlurb: Flatmates, family, the people who use the car. Name it after who is in it.
groups.name: Name
groups.editBlurb: Taking somebody out takes away the lists they reached through this group, and nothing else.
groups.emptyBody: A group is worth making when you share the same lists with the same people more than once. Until then, sharing with them by name is less to keep up to date.

sidebarMenu.deleteBlurb: The list and everything on it goes. Nobody it was shared with keeps a copy.
sidebarMenu.renameBlurb: What the list is called, in the sidebar and on anything printed from it.

starter.coffee: Coffee — the good beans from the market
starter.coffeeNote:
### Where
Saturday market, second row.

- [ ] Ethiopian, whole bean

> They pack up around two.

print.footer: Tick as you go. Whatever gets remembered in the shop goes on the dashed lines.

public.nothingBody: This nooks instance has no public list. If you were sent a link, whoever sent it can publish one from their settings.
public.emptyBody: This page shows one list from {{name}}, so anybody can read it without an account. There is nothing on it at the moment.
public.signInToTick: Sign in to tick things off
public.signInBlurb: This page is read-only without an account.
public.readOnly: Read-only · anybody with the link can see this

publicSettings.title: Public list
publicSettings.blurb: One list, at an address anybody can open without an account. Everything else on this instance stays private.
publicSettings.whichListBlurb: Only one list can be public at a time.
publicSettings.showNamesBlurb: Visitors see the items, not who added them.
publicSettings.showMetaBlurb: The metadata a shopper actually needs.
publicSettings.allowJoinBlurb: Adds a quiet link at the foot of the page.
